title: Umunzane Waje Gusenyuka
intro: Mu karere kateye igomwe kandi gateye imbere, umuryango utera imbere wararetse ukunzi w’inda kwonona isoko. Uwo mugwi wari uzwi kubera ubuhinga bwo gucuruza n’umusesekara uva mu mirima yari ikikuje, wari uhanganye n’uguhamagarwa n’ubutungane n’ukwizera. Yamara rero, ubwibone bw’ubutunzi bwatuma umuntu atera umugongo, maze igitutu c’umwiza kirateranira ku musozi.
clues: Twari umuryango w’abadandaza utunze uba hagati y’amatongo n’amashamba.
Twarahenda abantu mu bipimo no mu bipimo, dukwiragiza ibiturire mu gihugu.
Twaragabishijwe n’intumwa yacu ngo dusenge Allah wenyene kandi dutange ingero yuzuye.
Twaratwengeye intumwa yacu, dusaba ko igihano kizoza nimba ari umunyakuri.
Twarafashwe n’igihano c’Umusi w’Igitutu igihe igicu cadupfutse.
Nzwi nk’Abagenzi b’Ibiti, abantu Shu’ayb yarungitsweko.
